steps.label: Pull the stranded villager up
steps.description: Find the rescue rope at Echo Bridge. Press E and stay close while you pull the villager up.
steps.name: Stranded villager
steps.result: The villager is safe. Tin points out a freshly cut support. This was no accident.

steps.label: Brace the crossing with Carpenter Tin
steps.description: The tools are here. Hold the support while Tin pins it in place.
steps.name: Carpenter Tin
steps.result: The crossing is reinforced. A witness saw someone run toward the bell hill.

steps.label: Escort the injured villager
steps.description: The injured villager is unsteady and the bridge bank can still give way. Walk with them to the first-aid lay-by on Bell Hill Road.
steps.name: Injured villager
steps.result: The villager is seated at the first-aid lay-by and points out fresh tracks up the hill.

destination.label: First-aid lay-by on Bell Hill Road
destination.arrival: The villager is seated at the first-aid lay-by and points out fresh tracks up the hill.

obstacle.label: Secure the plank at the eroded bank
obstacle.text: The injured villager cannot cross the slipping plank.

steps.label: Inspect the cut anchor rope
steps.description: Check the clean cut and the tracks leading uphill.
steps.result: A strip of cloth is caught on the rocks. The saboteur is still nearby.

steps.label: Catch up with the saboteur
steps.description: Press E to give chase. Catch up, or meet the runner at the end of the path.
steps.name: Saboteur
steps.result: The saboteur reveals where the attack is headed. The crossing is secure. You receive 35 coins.

water:0.title: Evacuate the landing

steps.label: Escort the sick villager
steps.description: The tainted relief water left the villager dizzy and at risk of falling off the landing. Walk them to first aid by Lotus Pond.
steps.name: Dizzy villager
steps.result: The villager is safe on dry ground. Moc An brings the forged wax seal to the station.

destination.label: Lotus Pond first-aid station
destination.arrival: The villager is safe on dry ground. Moc An brings the forged wax seal to the station.

obstacle.label: Move the overturned relief crate
obstacle.text: The crate blocks the landing. The dizzy villager needs a clear, dry passage.

script: The villager just woke up. They say the whole barrel came from one cart. Look closely at this seal.
There is a flame, but they pressed fresh wax over an older mark. Show me where they unloaded the cart.

steps.label: Close the warehouse valve
steps.description: Stay by the valve while you shut off the contaminated supply.
steps.result: The contaminated supply has stopped.

steps.label: Open the clean water branch
steps.description: Open the second control so clean water can reach the landing.
steps.result: Clean water is running again. Moc An can testify here.

steps.label: Inspect the altered connection
steps.description: Check the connector while Moc An compares the records.
steps.result: The connector was recently altered. Another line is still glowing.

steps.label: Isolate the chakra line
steps.description: Stay by the connector with the seal fragment while Moc An locates the prisoners.
steps.result: The extraction line is weakened. The prisoners are just ahead.

fire:2.title: A Crimson Lotus for Ha Ly

steps.label: Check Ha Ly’s wounds
steps.description: Check on Ha Ly in the prison after defeating her two captors.
script: Both guards are down. Can you hear me?
Ha Ly! She’s passed out. I have to tell Mother Hong.

steps.label: Tell Mother Hong
steps.description: Go outside the prison and tell Ha Ly’s mother what happened.
script: Mother Hong, Ha Ly is badly wounded. She just passed out.
Find Medic Dan at the clinic and bring her here quickly.
I’ll go inside and tend to her wounds while I wait. Ha Ly, I’m here.

steps.label: Find and escort Medic Dan
steps.description: Meet Medic Dan at the clinic and walk with her to the prison.
steps.name: Medic Dan
steps.result: Medic Dan has reached the prison. Go inside to see her examine Ha Ly.

destination.label: Ha Ly’s prison entrance
destination.arrival: Medic Dan has arrived at the prison entrance.

steps.label: Watch Medic Dan examine Ha Ly
steps.description: Return to Ha Ly to hear Medic Dan’s diagnosis.
script: The bleeding has stopped for now. Her pulse is weak, and ordinary medicine won’t be enough.
Is there anything that can save her?
A fresh Crimson Lotus from Crimson Lotus Peak. I can make the medicine from its petals.
I’ll climb up and find a flower. Stay here with her.

steps.label: Meet the keeper at Crimson Lotus Peak
steps.description: Climb Red Ash Cliff and ask the keeper for a Crimson Lotus.
script: Stop. The Crimson Lotus is the village’s treasure. I cannot simply give it to an outsider.
Someone is dying. I only need one flower for medicine. I’ll go straight back down.
A plea is not enough for me to break that rule. If you mean to go further, face me.
I don’t want to fight you. But she hasn’t much time.

steps.label: Speak to the keeper after the duel
steps.description: Lower your weapon and hear what the keeper has to say.
script: Please… don’t take that Crimson Lotus. I’ve watched over it through so many winters.
I understand why you want to keep it. But I need that flower to save someone.
Who are you trying to save?
Ha Ly… I see. Take the flower and hurry back down.
Take this book as well. It teaches Hỏa Long Cuồng Vũ. Use it to protect the person you came here to save.

steps.label: Bring the Crimson Lotus back to Medic Dan
steps.description: Return to the prison so Medic Dan can prepare the medicine and treat Ha Ly.
script: I brought the Crimson Lotus. How is she?
Give me the flower. I’ll prepare the medicine here.
Ha Ly, I’m here. Open your eyes slowly.
Her pulse is stronger now. Let her rest a little.

lightning:0.title: Restore the lightning relay

steps.label: Ground the residential circuit
steps.description: Hold the ground connection while Tu Khang works the control panel.
steps.result: The electrical surge has been diverted from the houses.

steps.label: Reset the relay breaker
steps.description: Stay by the breaker while Tu Khang restores power.
steps.result: The relay is working. Tu Khang finds the occupation order in the control box.

script: The lights are back. Wait. There is a slip of paper under the breaker.
Let me see. This is a Lightning troop cipher. Someone changed a line after the seal was applied.
I saw a correction like that in the Fire orders. Keep both copies.

steps.label: Catch up with the fleeing courier
steps.description: Start the chase and close the distance. The courier will stop at the end of the path.
steps.name: False courier
steps.result: You have cut off the courier. He draws his weapon and calls for help.

steps.label: Hold the support while Son wedges it
steps.description: Stay by the cracked support while Son secures it.
steps.result: The roof is braced. You can clear a rescue opening.

steps.label: Clear an air gap for the miners
steps.description: Help clear the rubble until the trapped miners can breathe freely.
steps.result: Air is flowing and the miners answer. The rescue rope is ready.

steps.label: Escort the miners out of the rockfall zone
steps.description: The miners are out of the shaft but still in the rockfall area. Walk with them to the assembly point so Son can count the crew and receive their sample.
steps.name: Rescued miner
steps.result: Son has counted the crew. A miner hands over a crystal sample for examination at the assembly point.

destination.label: Mine crew assembly point
destination.arrival: Son has counted the crew. A miner hands over a crystal sample for examination at the assembly point.

obstacle.label: Brace the rockfall passage
obstacle.text: Loose rock slid onto the path. Brace the edge so the miners can pass.

wood:3.title: Contain the poison at the roots

steps.label: Steady the seal at a living root
steps.description: Stay near the seal while Ha Ly and Linh Chi draw out the poison.
steps.result: The poison has left the living roots. Seal the containment vessel now.

steps.label: Seal the containment vessel
steps.description: Hold the lid while Linh Chi locks the vessel.
steps.result: The poison is contained. New growth appears at the roots.

steps.label: Escort the survivors to the shelter lantern
steps.description: The storm is erasing the tracks and the injured traveler cannot find their way alone. Escort them to the shelter lantern to warm up before reporting to the chief.
steps.name: Injured traveler
steps.result: Everyone reaches the lantern. Tuyet Nghi is reunited with her child, and the young mage can speak before the group enters the council hall.

destination.label: Storm shelter lantern by the Frozen Lake
destination.arrival: Everyone reaches the lantern. Tuyet Nghi is reunited with her child, and the young mage can speak before the group enters the council hall.

obstacle.label: Shield the group lantern
obstacle.text: A gust put out the lantern. Hold the windbreak until the light returns.

steps.label: Break the prison seal
steps.description: Stay beside the seal to release the last lock.
steps.result: The door is open. A guard is leading the prisoners into the yard.

steps.label: Escort the guard to the rally point
steps.description: The freed prisoners are still scattered. Escort the guard to the rally yard to count them and hand them over to the relief team.
steps.name: Rescued guard
steps.result: The guard gathers the survivors. The chief receives the group, and you can go to the council hall to discuss the route to Dark Village.

destination.label: Rally yard outside the prison
destination.arrival: The guard gathers the survivors. The chief receives the group, and you can go to the council hall to discuss the route to Dark Village.

obstacle.label: Open the evacuation barrier
obstacle.text: The old barrier still blocks the yard. Open it so the group can move through together.

steps.label: Release the first seal connection
steps.description: Ha Ly watches the Jade Deer while you loosen the first seal.
steps.result: One lock has cracked. The other connection is still draining the guardian.

steps.label: Release the second seal connection
steps.description: Disconnect the remaining seal to open the way out for the guardian.
steps.result: The Jade Deer is free and the route to the next commander is open.

steps.label: Escort the last group to safety
steps.description: The ritual area is still unsafe even after the leader has fallen. Escort the last evacuee to the post where the guards can take over.
steps.name: Freed villager
steps.result: The last evacuee has reached the post. The guards take over, and you can question the defeated leader in the council hall.

destination.label: Evacuation post outside the stronghold
destination.arrival: The last evacuee has reached the post. The guards take over, and you can question the defeated leader in the council hall.

obstacle.label: Isolate the leaking seal
obstacle.text: The seal is still discharging over the exit. Hold the fragment in place to cut the current.

steps.label: Light the evacuation lantern
steps.description: Light the path behind the defensive line so residents can move to safety.
steps.result: The lantern guides the residents away from the front.

steps.label: Stabilize the barrier with the alliance
steps.description: Hold position at the barrier while the villages channel chakra together.
steps.result: The barrier holds. The vanguard is approaching.

ui.dispatchAction: Accept the mission and set out
ui.return: Return to the marker to continue
ui.escort: Stay beside the person you are escorting
ui.enabled: New mission route enabled. Your current progress has been kept.

dispatch: I came from the bridge. Everyone is on dry ground. Tin sends his thanks.
The saboteur wanted to cut off help. I saw him run toward the people attacking the Nameless Beast.
Take the seal fragment to the Water landing. If anyone is trying to turn the villages against each other, look for their trail there. I will teach you the remaining two signs before you leave.
